notes.no_install_action: this config intentionally defines no install/apply/commit action - see spec P36
notes.placeholders: {WORKSPACE_ROOT} and {USER_HOME} are resolved at runtime; never hardcode absolute paths
notes.t1_effective_threshold: agent_count_ceiling x agent_count_headroom = 200 x 1.0 = 200; a host that changes the headroom changes the threshold
notes.host_metrics: T1 (agent_count) and T3 (routing_accuracy) are host-supplied: the host writes them via -Action record-metrics or the drop directory; stale or undersampled data makes T1/T3 skip, never guess (references/scaling.md section 3.1)
notes.file_count_basis: package file set = all package files minus repository tooling directories (.git/ .github/ .workbuddy/ .skill-upgrade/) and build residues (__pycache__/ *.pyc); references/scaling.md section 2
notes.tier_order: canonical tier vocabulary in ascending order; drives -TargetTier validation (ordinal comparison) and the vocabulary error message
notes.upgrade_path: the DEFAULT (linear) next tier per source tier, used when -TargetTier is omitted; each value must be the first entry of selectable_targets for that tier (drift fails with SCL_007)
notes.selectable_targets: every target tier selectable via -Action propose -TargetTier <tier>; the first entry is the default. large->group is a scaffold proposal (UPGRADE-WORK-ORDER.txt; content gates fail by design and nothing is recorded in the state file)
